role: The checked exception thrown by AnvilConverter when a legacy save cannot be converted.
notes: Nothing in this codebase converts legacy saves: worlds are created fresh from a seed in world.conf, and the native engine has no save-format conversion at all. This is the save-conversion exception, not the anvil block. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Only AnvilSaveConverter's legacy-save conversion throws it; the oracle's worlds are fresh Anvil saves and its start-up scan converts nothing (see AnvilSaveConverter), and the native engine loads snapshots.
